name: Quest Requests
vision_statement: Every request made in Quest is taken in once by the same AI.
opportunities: A runner is reached from many places and each has its own failure and cost, which the parent solution measures one by one and none together: a short chat message must not pay for a long run, an image has to be described before it can ground an answer, input that arrives while a run works must be heard at the next decision, a terminal session needs helper calls that cost a fraction of a cent, and a developer needs a package that installs and runs on an empty environment, learned from documents and examples that are kept true.
solution_coherence: Quest Requests takes every request in once and gives each Quest surface the same understanding of it. Take In The World accepts a request from a chat channel, the terminal or the embedded package and says where it goes. Receive Input Mid Run holds what a person sends while work runs and hands it to the run's next decision exactly once. Describe An Attachment turns an attached image into text the AI can use.
